items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He was on those Jelly Roll records, Stomp Evans.

ctx.x: Uh, we, there was, uh, a kid played sax, Joe, uh, Joe Poston, one. No, no. Jimmy Noon. Yeah, he was with Jimmy Noon. This little guy was a little short fella, Joe, uh, I can't think of Joe's name, I haven't seen him before. Was there an Evans?

No. He was on those Jelly Roll records, Stomp Evans. Oh, I know who you're talking about. It wasn't him. No, no, it wasn't him. Oh, I can't think of those fellas. Well, that's alright, yes. And there was another one, then Lewis would come down after the theater, see, after the theater,

he played at the, uh, at the, uh, Vendome Theater. And after the theater was over, he'd come down and play. Mm-hmm. Was it Ori? No. See, Roy Palmer was around, and Venson, and Dutre. Dutre, he was with Joe. And Dutre, he was with Joe. Yeah. And then he was playing at the theater, see, after, he played at the, uh, Vendome Theater. And after the theater was over, he'd come down and play. Mm-hmm. And, okay, we had two, two topics and trombone. I think, uh, seems to me like Ori was playing trombone. Was it Ori? No.…
